facts.fact: African Capital Markets News reports that Ethiopian retail investors paid about ETB 3 billion at ETB 300 a share in Ethio Telecom's initial public offering, run from October 2024 to February 2025.

African Capital Markets News reports that about 45,000 Ethiopian shareholders paid some ETB 3 billion in Ethio Telecom's share offering on the Ethiopian Securities Exchange, which listed the shares on 26 May 2026.
